description: Convert between UTC, your local time and any fixed UTC offset — with an honest note about daylight saving.

faqs.a: UTC → your local time, UTC → any chosen UTC offset, and your local time → UTC.
No — it uses fixed offsets. Some regions shift by an hour for daylight saving, so always double-check meeting times for DST regions.
faqs.q: Does it handle daylight saving time?

faqs.a: All standard zones from UTC−12:00 to UTC+14:00, including half- and quarter-hour offsets like +5:30 and +5:45.

howto: Enter a UTC date/time and pick a target offset — or enter your local time.
Read the converted time with its offset label.
Remember DST is not applied automatically.
